summary: Closure review: the authors resolved the requirement to state that the preregistered benign-control was not executed (Methods and Results). However two prior required manuscript-level fixes remain unaddressed: the Disclosure Statement still exposes run-internal file paths/hashes and is overly verbose, and the manuscript still contains run-internal artifact paths/DOI/URL strings in narrative prose rather than using concise IEEE-numbered citations and referencing the archived execution manifest. These must be fixed before finalisation. All other scientific concerns (preregistration fidelity, primary analysis, paired-design accounting, and archival evidence) appear adequately documented in the supplied artifacts; no new experiments are required.
critical_issues: Disclosure Statement in the submitted manuscript still duplicates run-internal file paths and full artifact hashes in prose (violates the track requirement to keep the Disclosure concise and to leave run-level provenance in the archived evidence bundle).

Methods and Results still contain explicit run-internal file paths and artifact filenames/paths (e.g., execution/task_manifest.jsonl, execution/responses/...), rather than citing the archived execution manifest with a standard IEEE-numbered reference; this contradicts the prior required revision to remove per-file provenance from ordinary narrative.

Some bibliographic and artifact references remain presented as raw DOIs/URLs/run-paths in narrative prose; the manuscript must use standard IEEE-numbered citations in the body and ensure each cited bibliographic record supports the adjacent claim.
required_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement so it contains only the mandatory high-level content (models used, orchestration adapter, autonomy-lock boundary, protocol deviations, high-level artifact availability). Remove per-file paths and full hashes from the main text; instead cite the archived execution/execution_manifest.json (use an IEEE-numbered reference) and note that the full hash manifest is available in the artifact bundle.

Replace all run-internal file paths and artifact filenames that appear in Methods, Results, Figures/Tables captions, or Disclosure prose with an IEEE-numbered citation referencing the archived execution manifest or artifact archive. Do not list ordinary run-level paths or full hashes in the manuscript body; retain them only in the archived artifact bundle referenced by the citation.

Convert any remaining raw DOI/URL occurrences in the manuscript prose to standard IEEE numeric citations and verify that each cited bibliographic record explicitly supports the nearby scholarly claim (fix any mismatches).
optional_revisions: Add a brief paragraph in Discussion summarizing practical significance given the ceiling effect (guarded=100%) and the small discordant count (n10=6) to help readers interpret operational relevance beyond statistical detectability.

Provide a short, high-level table (or point to an archived table) enumerating the six discordant pairs with a simple diagnostic label (sanitizer-only vs repair-applied) so readers can quickly see repair vs sanitization contributions; keep low-level traces and full artifacts in the archive rather than in the paper.

Explicitly recommend the provider sampling parameter for deterministic reproduction (e.g., temperature=0) in Methods and in the Disclosure and cite the execution manifest where the current unset temperature is recorded.
